title: Air Conditioning — Cargo Compartment Heating — Replacement of the Vented Temperature Transmitter
abstract: Replacement of the vented cargo compartment temperature transmitter by a sealed unit on the seven aircraft built from the affected supplier batch, ending erroneous low-temperature indications after a cold soak.

sections.planning_reason: Seven aircraft from one supplier batch reported erroneous low cargo temperature indications, always after a cold soak and always clearing within twenty minutes of the heating system running. Nineteen events were logged in ten months, six of which led to a live animal shipment being refused at the gate. Two returned transmitters were found with moisture ingress at the vent, a feature present only on the early build standard. The affected population is small and closed, which is why this Service Bulletin is written against a fixed aircraft list rather than a range.
sections.description: The vented temperature transmitter is replaced by a sealed unit on the same bracket, with a new washer set and a repositioned drip loop in the harness. The connectors of the actuator and the solenoid in the same loop are re-sealed to the current standard practice, because the moisture path runs along the harness as well as through the transmitter vent. No change is made to the heating duct, the trim valve or the controller.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Make the aircraft electrically safe and open the aft cargo compartment lining locally in zone 172. Disconnect and remove the vented transmitter. Install the sealed transmitter D2140118706760 on the existing bracket with the washer set EN889198-3B. Reposition the harness drip loop so that it hangs below the connector, to the dimension in the accomplishment instructions. Get access to the equipment area in zone 273 and re-seal the connectors of the actuator 181HM and the solenoid 9469HM. Do the operational test of task AMM-M-21-40-11-700-016-A and confirm that the indication stabilises inside the revised time. Close the lining and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable only to the seven listed aircraft, which are the aircraft delivered with the affected supplier build standard and which are still pre MOD-162530. No other aircraft in the fleet carries the vented transmitter and this Service Bulletin must not be applied outside the list.
sections.material_note: Kit K2140-1052-01 contains one sealed transmitter, the washer set and the connector sealing content. Kits were built to order against the seven aircraft. The removed transmitters are to be returned to Aeralis for the supplier investigation.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled A-check, or within 18 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
